# README

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/fawda123/SWMPr/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/fawda123/SWMPr/actions)
[![pkgdown](https://github.com/fawda123/SWMPr/workflows/pkgdown/badge.svg)](https://github.com/fawda123/SWMPr/actions)
[![Codecov test
coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/fawda123/SWMPr/branch/master/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/fawda123/SWMPr?branch=master)
[![CRAN
status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/SWMPr)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=SWMPr)
[![](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/SWMPr)](http://cran.rstudio.com/package=SWMPr)

![](reference/figures/swmpr_logo.png)

The System Wide Monitoring Program
([SWMP](http://nerrs.noaa.gov/RCDefault.aspx?ID=18)) was implemented by
the National Estuarine Research Reserve System
([NERRS](http://nerrs.noaa.gov/)) in 1995 to provide continuous
monitoring data at over 140 continuous monitoring stations in 28
estuaries across the United States. SWMPr (pronounced “swamper”) is an R
package for retrieving, organizing, and analyzing estuary monitoring
data from SWMP.

Please see the [paper](https://doi.org/10.32614/RJ-2016-015) for getting
started with SWMPr. A
[cookbook](https://swmprats.net/all-about-swmpr/swmpr-cookbook/) is also
available, including workshop materials, on
[swmprats.net](https://swmprats.net/).

# Issues and suggestions

Please report any issues and suggestions on the [issues
link](https://github.com/fawda123/SWMPr/issues) for the repository.

A guide to posting issues can be found
[here](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/ISSUE_TEMPLATE.md).

# Contributing

Please view our
[contributing](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/CONTRIBUTING.md)
guidelines for any changes or pull requests.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`aggremetab()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/aggremetab.md)
  : Aggregate metabolism data
- [`aggreswmp()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/aggreswmp.md)
  : Aggregate swmpr data
- [`all_params()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/all_params.md)
  : Import current station records from the CDMO
- [`all_params_dtrng()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/all_params_dtrng.md)
  : Get CDMO records within a date range
- [`apacpnut`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/apacpnut.md) :
  Example nutrient data for Apalachicola Bay Cat Point station.
- [`apacpwq`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/apacpwq.md) :
  Example water quality data for Apalachicola Bay Cat Point station.
- [`apadbwq`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/apadbwq.md) :
  Example water quality data for Apalachicola Bay Dry Bar station.
- [`apaebmet`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/apaebmet.md) :
  Example weather data for Apalachicola Bay East Bay station.
- [`calckl()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/calckl.md) :
  Calculate oxygen mass transfer coefficient
- [`cens_id()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/cens_id.md) :
  Flag observations above/below detection limits
- [`comb()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/comb.md) :
  Combine swmpr data
- [`decomp()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/decomp.md) :
  Simple trend decomposition
- [`decompTs()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/decompTs.md)
  : Decompose a time series
- [`decomp_cj()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/decomp_cj.md)
  : Simple trend decomposition of monthly swmpr data
- [`ecometab()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/ecometab.md)
  : Ecosystem metabolism
- [`gradcols()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/gradcols.md)
  : Get colors for plots
- [`hist(`*`<swmpr>`*`)`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/hist.swmpr.md)
  : Plot swmpr using a histogram
- [`import_local()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/import_local.md)
  : Import local CDMO data
- [`map_reserve()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/map_reserve.md)
  : Map a reserve
- [`metab_day()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/metab_day.md)
  : Identify metabolic days in a time series
- [`na.approx(`*`<swmpr>`*`)`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/na.approx.swmpr.md)
  : Linearly interpolate gaps
- [`overplot()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/overplot.md)
  : Plot multiple SWMP time series on the same y-axis
- [`oxySol()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/oxySol.md) :
  Dissolved oxygen at saturation
- [`param_names()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/param_names.md)
  : Get parameters of a given type
- [`parser()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/parser.md) :
  Parse web results for swmpr
- [`plot(`*`<swmpr>`*`)`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/plot.swmpr.md)
  [`lines(`*`<swmpr>`*`)`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/plot.swmpr.md)
  : Plot swmpr data
- [`plot_metab()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/plot_metab.md)
  : Plot ecosystem metabolism for a swmpr object
- [`plot_quants()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/plot_quants.md)
  : Create a plot of data for a single year overlaid on historical data.
- [`plot_summary()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/plot_summary.md)
  : Plot graphical summaries of SWMP data
- [`plot_wind()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/plot_wind.md)
  : Create a wind rose
- [`qaqc()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/qaqc.md) : QAQC
  filtering for SWMP data
- [`qaqcchk()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/qaqcchk.md) :
  Summary of QAQC flags in SWMP data
- [`rem_reps()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/rem_reps.md)
  : Remove replicates in nutrient data
- [`setstep()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/setstep.md) :
  Format a swmpr time vector
- [`single_param()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/single_param.md)
  : Get CDMO records for a single parameter
- [`site_codes()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/site_codes.md)
  : Obtain metadata for all stations
- [`site_codes_ind()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/site_codes_ind.md)
  : Obtain metadata for a single reserve
- [`smoother()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/smoother.md)
  : Smooth swmpr data
- [`stat_locs`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/stat_locs.md)
  : Locations of NERRS sites
- [`subset(`*`<swmpr>`*`)`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/subset.swmpr.md)
  : Subset a swmpr object
- [`sun_times()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/sun_times.md)
  : Estimate sunrise and sunset times
- [`swmpr()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/swmpr.md) :
  Create a swmpr object
- [`time_vec()`](http://fawda123.github.io/SWMPr/reference/time_vec.md)
  : Format SWMP datetimestamp
